image_description: A dimly lit interior view of a prison cell block, featuring two levels of cells facing each other across a central walkway. The walls are distressed concrete or plaster with peeling paint. Metal railings line the upper walkways, and barred cell doors are visible on both levels. A staircase is visible in the background leading to the lower level.

To verify the perspective lines of the walkways and railings converge correctly and do not exhibit spatial warping.
To ensure the thin metal bars of the cells and railings are continuous and do not melt into the background or walls.

custom_prompts_for_reflector: Pay close attention to the background depth; AI often struggles with complex repeating structures like railings in the distance. Verify if the 'bars' are physically attached to the frames or if they float/merge.
